THE FINER DETAILS

A few things
you might ask.

Let's talk
How do I order?+

Choose your texture, length and quantity, then review your enquiry message. Once the business WhatsApp number is connected, you can open WhatsApp and send it yourself. MKM will confirm the details before you place an order.

Are the displayed prices in US dollars?+

Yes. All listed prices are in USD. They are reference prices by length. The exact product, any texture or construction adjustments, taxes and delivery costs must be confirmed with MKM.

Is every length and texture available?+

Availability has to be checked directly. Choosing an option is an enquiry about your preference and does not reserve stock. The photos are inspiration until product-to-photo details are confirmed.

Can you help me choose a texture?+

Yes — include what you are looking for in your enquiry. Ask for current photos, product specifications and advice on the available options before deciding.

Where do you deliver, and can I return my order?+

Please confirm delivery locations, charges, timing, cancellation and returns terms with MKM before paying. These details are awaiting approval for the website.
